items: New: Less like this: tap ••• on any post (or press H). It folds with an Undo and that topic cools off.
New: Keys on the dashboard: O shows a folded post, H is less like this, G switches For you and Following, Alt+Shift+D opens Dashwell. Tumblr's own L and R keys now teach Dashwell too.
New: App: pull down at the top of the feed to refresh, bigger tap targets. Existing installs get the feed changes over the air.
Fix: For you's folds no longer leak into the chronological Following tab.
Fix: A thumb fling no longer counts as skipping every post.
Fix: A skip counts once per topic, not once per tag.
Fix: The discovery slot actually fires now.
Fix: Time spent reading a post counts as a light signal.
Fix: Muted words save instantly; opening a favorite's post marks it read.
Android: fixed image upload when posting (the photo picker's result was being dropped).
Android: the app can receive page-script and style updates over the air (signed, applied on next launch).
The feed no longer stalls at the bottom: if nothing new loads it nudges the scroll, presses retry, and on For you reloads as a last resort.
Android: the screen could go black when opening or closing Tumblr's menu. Fixed.
Ad blocking: the rules that hide in-feed sponsored posts weren't applying. They are now.
Smoother scrolling on phones. New logo. New website: https://a3ro-dev.github.io/dashwell/
Your Tumblr login survives the app being closed right after you sign in, and updates install over the top without logging you out.

title: now on Android
items: Android app: Tumblr with Dashwell built in. Ads blocked at the network level, no "Rather use the app?" banners, settings behind one icon in Tumblr's top bar, update notices.
A held-back post is one calm line ("You've seen a lot of #marvel lately · Show"); settings are plain switches and sentences.
Mute words, #tags and @blogs, caught even inside other people's reblogs.
Following stays chronological with flood control, plus Open Following first.
No "Check out these communities" carousels, no Go Premium, real tab titles.
Sentence tags like #his baby! no longer count as topics.

title: CaliStream
items: One like can't flood your feed: topics get slots proportional to your long-term interest.
Scroll past a topic fast and it cools down for the session; three real engagements and it follows your new obsession.
Tags are grouped on-device by co-occurrence (#black holes counts toward #space).
Joke tags are ignored, repeat reblogs collapse, max 2 posts per blog per 16, 1 discovery slot in 10.
Mutuals are found by tie strength relative to how much they post, and never collapsed.
Every decision explains itself; Show anyway teaches it.
Hides the top-bar Go Premium button.
First release: no ads, a feed that doesn't flood you after one like, a never-miss-a-mutual badge, and an option to hide Go Premium.
